headline: Japan Tobacco Takes $8.9 Billion Charge Following Seizure of Russian Operations
summary: Japan Tobacco booked an $8.9 billion charge following the seizure of its Russian business, causing the Tokyo-based company to shift from a projected profit to an operating loss of 368 billion yen.
why: Japan Tobacco is a major global consumer products and tobacco manufacturer whose financial results were heavily impacted by geopolitical sanctions and asset seizures in Russia.

impacts.name: Japan Tobacco
impacts.why: The company recorded an $8.9 billion charge and plunged into an operating loss due to its Russian asset seizure.
